name: chess
text: chess is the standard English label, but applied to the early insular board-games it gives a misleading translation. The label covers a handful of distinct Irish and Welsh traditions, including fidchell, gwyddbwyll, and búanfach, each with its own rules and lore. Scholars therefore warn against treating chess as a precise term for any single one of these games.

attributes.attribute: misleading English label used for several distinct early Irish and Welsh board-games

okr.objective: Document the misleading use of chess as a label for early Celtic board-games.
key_results: Flags chess as a misleading translation.
Names fidchell, gwyddbwyll, and búanfach as distinct games covered by the label.
